title: Morena Mayor Organized Armed Group Which Shot at CNTE Teachers in Oaxaca
author: Jorge A. Pérez Alfonso
content:
_This article by Jorge A. Pérez Alfonso originally appeared in the[May 27,
2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/05/27/estados/cnte-denuncia-
ataque-armado-de-habitantes-y-edil-de-san-pablo-en-la-oaxacaistmo), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/image-168.png)_Esaú López Quero_

**Tlacolula de Matamoros, Oaxaca**. Residents of the municipality of San Pablo
Villa de Mitla, led by their mayor, Esaú López Quero, a member of the Morena
party, attacked the blockade that teachers from Section 22 of the National
Coordinator of Education Workers (CNTE), from the Sierra, Isthmus and
Tlacolula regions, were maintaining on Federal Highway 190 Oaxaca-Isthmus; the
local branch reports at least 10 teachers being held.

Teachers from the Matías Romero area explained that the Morena party mayor
arrived at the blockade, demanding its removal. After a dialogue, the teachers
agreed to move to the side of the road and allow free passage; they only asked
for time to do so. However, the mayor's companions, who were carrying high-
caliber weapons, began to shoot.

This caused panic, and their companions began to destroy the mentors'
vehicles. Subsequently, the teachers decided to retreat to the Tanivet agency,
near the penitentiary of the same name, where they maintain a blockade and are
burning tires.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/image-169.png)_Morena Mayor Esaú López Quero 's armed
gang kidnapped up to 10 teachers, mostly women, after firing on the teachers,
[according to CNTE S 22
Huajuapan](https://www.facebook.com/CNTE.Huajuapan/posts/pfbid024BFGVKRvdDAJ9maLU4ddUQiNxeYbE8VRTuoEKCaoV2ARbCToc5PGovtrtWMo4GWBl?__cft__\[0\]=AZZqXkW0VVme5-FFIHOwfdtFVR5ZJVElilSQh0QLYQ8rfFr7184ggnix5bvwrosr9T8pwSLg-

ErBQr&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R) who acquired this photo from aghast residents of the
village._
